objective: Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

description: It is rumored that the Dark Iron Hurley Blackbreath has stolen a recipe for ale.  This ale, Thunderbrew Lager, is said to infuse its imbiber with great strength and courage.  We wish to study the drink.  Perhaps, we will find other applications for its virtues... applications more in line with Forsaken objectives.
Delve into Blackrock Depths, find Hurley, take from him the recipe for Thunderbrew lager and bring it to me.
And to find him, you may have to entice him by threatening his precious ale.
progress: Do you have the recipe for the Thunderbrew Lager, <name>?
completion: Very good. I will send this recipe to the Apothecarium to be studied, and in time we will unlock its secrets. One day, the dwarves of the Alliance may find the virtues of this drink used against them!
I find that terribly amusing. Perhaps death has an affect on one's sense of humor... do you think?

note:
Break the three kegs in the Grim Guzzler storeroom to spawn Hurley Blackbreath and his guards.
